name: InterContinental London Park Lane
positioning: Mayfair hotel at One Hamilton Place overlooking the Royal Parks, on the site of Queen Elizabeth II's childhood home
best_for: Travelers who want a Mayfair base beside the Royal Parks
Suite travelers wanting park and Wellington Arch views

facts.text: The hotel overlooks the Royal Parks and sits in the heart of Mayfair.
The address is One Hamilton Place, Park Lane, London.
The hotel stands on the site of 145 Piccadilly, Queen Elizabeth II's former childhood residence.
The hotel was designed by Sir Frederick Gibberd, whose other designs include Liverpool Metropolitan Cathedral and London Central Mosque.
The hotel was opened by the 8th Duke of Wellington in 1975.
Guest rooms have London views ranging from Buckingham Palace to the Royal Parks.
Premium Rooms have bathrooms stocked with Byredo toiletries.
Guests have complimentary access to a 24-hour gym with free weights and cardio equipment.
Theo Randall Cucina Italiana is the hotel's Italian restaurant, led by Chef Theo Randall.
The Wellington Lounge serves traditional afternoon tea on the former site of 145 Piccadilly.
The Club InterContinental lounge offers complimentary breakfast, afternoon tea, and evening drinks and canapés.
InterContinental Hair Salon & Grooming offers hairdressing, styling and grooming.

highlights.text: The London Suite is a penthouse duplex with floor-to-ceiling windows framing views of the Royal Parks and Wellington Arch, and a floating staircase.
The hotel has views of Green Park and Wellington Arch.
Spa InterContinental offers facials, massages and body treatments using products from Aromatherapy Associates and Dr. Renaud Botanical.
The Capital Suite has private lift access, a separate hotel entrance and a full-size boardroom.
After a jog through the royal parks, runners can use a complimentary refreshment station with towels, water and apples.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
The hotel is within the Central London Congestion Charge Zone, which matters for guests arriving by car.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury Mayfair location.
